groups.label: Kelana Jaya
groups.source: rapid-rail.zip routes.txt route_color D50032 on KJ (LRT Kelana Jaya Line). Pinned at dL -0.22 (trail #cf3f49, line #ab383e): a full red, darker than the Ampang orange; deuteranopes see it lighter than the Kajang green and protanopes darker (0.080 and 0.071 apart).

groups.label: Ampang lines
groups.source: rapid-rail.zip routes.txt route_color E57200 on AG (LRT Ampang Line, 14 trains at 08:18). The Sri Petaling Line (PH, 76232F, 25 trains) shares its trunk and joins it; maroon would draw the pink #ff9ea4. Pinned at dL -0.10 (trail #ee7a17, line #994a00): a true orange, and 0.093 from the Monorail lime for deuteranopes where the source step is 0.025.

groups.label: Kajang
groups.source: rapid-rail.zip routes.txt route_color 047940 on KGL (MRT Kajang Line). Pinned at dL -0.28 (trail #0f7d44, line #00713b): dark green, as on the KL map, and apart from the Ampang orange (protanopia 0.098) and the Kelana Jaya red (0.071).

groups.label: Putrajaya
groups.source: rapid-rail.zip routes.txt route_color FFCD00 on PYL (MRT Putrajaya Line). Pinned at dL +0.12 (trail #ffe291, line #c49d00) so it reads yellow, not mustard, and stays 0.098 from the Monorail lime for protanopes on their shared corridor north of KLCC.

groups.label: Monorail
groups.source: rapid-rail.zip routes.txt route_color 84BD00 on MR (KL Monorail Line). Free group, source step passes: trail #9bd343, line #638d0e.

groups.label: KTM
groups.source: ktmb.zip routes.txt route_color 3C5A9F on the Seremban Line (KC05_KB18), 4 of the group's 9 trains at 08:18, the most. The Port Klang Line (KA15_KD19, DC2420, 3), ETS (FFC72C, 2) and ERT (6E6E6E) share its tracks through Kuala Lumpur and join it. Free group, source step passes: trail #9ebdff, line #5a7bc3.
